relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 is known to contribute to peripheral sensitization in mice with SCD

key_findings: High-dose 8% topical capsaicin was safe and well tolerated in SCD patients
Treated site showed improved relative mechanical threshold (LPHR 26%, p=0.04), supporting a role for TRPV1 in localized hypersensitivity
